# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and reliability updates**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates platform integrations and fixes reliability and performance issues across managed and native code. The release aligns Uno and Windows dependencies with current platform versions, refreshes the bundled Skia m156 fixes, and improves image, stream, string, Android, and HarfBuzz workloads.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Bundled Skia receives m156 fixes** — Incorporates the latest upstream Chrome m156 bug fixes into the renderer shipped with SkiaSharp. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500), [#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489))

## Bug Fixes

- **String conversion validation corrected** — StringUtilities now validates Unicode character codes and string inputs correctly, and native C-string conversion no longer reads beyond its source buffer. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Image and text processing allocations reduced** — Managed image pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding, and native feature-string parsing avoid unnecessary allocations while preserving their results. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Stream and Android rendering behavior stabilized** — Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily, and Android texture rendering is synchronized with display refresh. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327), [#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Platform

- **Uno and Windows dependencies updated** — SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI now builds against Uno Platform 7, while Windows native dependencies align with MAUI 9 and 10. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
- **Native platform builds modernized** — Apple deployment targets, Windows build tooling, and bundled WebGPU support are updated for current platform environments. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
